exposure: Type of vacuum extractor (metal cup or Kiwi)
outcome: Maternal complications (perineal tears, cervical tears, need for blood transfusion)
Neonatal outcomes (jaundice, NICU admission, shoulder dystocia)
cohort: All women who underwent operative vaginal delivery at Dubai Hospital between 2018 and 2022.
finding: The incidence of operative vaginal delivery remained stable, with fetal distress as the primary indication, and an increasing trend of Kiwi vacuum extractor use over metal cups.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery with metal cups was associated with more maternal complications (perineal tears, need for suturing in the operating room, and blood transfusion) and neonatal shoulder dystocia compared to Kiwi vacuum or forceps, although the differences were not statistically significant.
